description: React component for displaying, previewing, and exporting student certificates in a grid view; includes functionalities for preview, PNG and PDF download, and utilizes external utils and mock data.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date string into a localized date format with error handling.

methods.name: handleOpenPreview
methods.description: Sets the current certificate to be previewed.

methods.name: handleDownloadPng
methods.description: Exports the currently previewed certificate as a PNG file.

methods.name: handleDownloadPdf
methods.description: Exports the currently previewed certificate as a PDF file.

methods.name: slugify
methods.description: Converts a string into a URL-friendly slug.
